description: Utilities for interacting with PostgreSQL databases. Provides connection management, query execution, and transaction handling for PostgreSQL database operations.

instructions.description: Creates Postgres connection pool using provided connection string or retrieves existing one with specified name.
instructions.name: Get connection

parameters.description: Connection string in the format of `postgres://user:pass@host:port/dbname`
parameters.name: connectionString

parameters.description: Resource name, if not provided `default` will be used
parameters.name: name

instructions.description: Queries Postgres to retrieve one row. The result is stored in the provided storage location. If multiple rows are returned, or none at all, the action will fail.
instructions.name: Query single row

parameters.description: Statement to execute like "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1"
parameters.name: statement

parameters.description: Array of parameters to be used in the statement like ["John"]
parameters.name: params

parameters.description: Resource name, if not provided `default` will be used
parameters.name: name

instructions.description: Queries Postgres to retrieve multiple rows. The result is stored in the provided storage location.
instructions.name: Query

parameters.description: Statement to execute like "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1"
parameters.name: statement

parameters.description: Array of parameters to be used in the statement like ["John"]
parameters.name: params

parameters.description: Resource name, if not provided `default` will be used
parameters.name: name

instructions.description: Executes query and returns number of affected rows. This is preferred action when executing INSERT or UPDATE statements.
instructions.name: Execute

parameters.description: Statement to execute like "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1"
parameters.name: statement

parameters.name: params

parameters.name: name
